title: Life Certificate for Pensioners 2026: Last Date, How to Submit Online and What If You Miss It
seoTitle: Life Certificate Last Date 2026: How to Submit Online
seoDescription: Pensioners must submit the life certificate by 30 November. See every way to submit, from Jeevan Pramaan face app to doorstep service, fees and late rules.
excerpt: Deadlines for under-80, 80-plus and EPS-95 pensioners, a step-by-step for the Jeevan Pramaan face app, a cost table for doorstep options, and the three-year rule if your pension has stopped.
